messages:
auditor_jen: Hi team — auditor here. For the SOC2 fieldwork next week we need proof that the emergency RBAC change (service-account bind -> admin) on 2024-11-02 was temporary and tied to CVE triage. Please provide: 1) the IAM change log, 2) the KMS key usage around the triage window, and 3) any incident ticket linking the change to the vuln. Can we get a packaged artifact?

lina_h: thanks jen. we have the iam audit stream in CloudTrail -> Splunk. KMS usage is in kms-usage-logs (KMS CloudWatch). incident ticket is TICKET-4591 (vuln triage). putting plan below.

sam_oncall: I can grab the Splunk snapshots. quick Splunk query that covers the bind event:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:iam::*:user/service-account-svc" earliest="2024-11-02T00:00:00" latest="2024-11-03T00:00:00"
| table _time, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters, responseElements
```
I'll export raw JSON and the saved search output. :white_check_mark:

matt_s: For KMS: we need decrypt/Encrypt calls, and any GenerateDataKey/GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext. KMS CloudWatch logs -> quick filter by KeyId. KMS key alias was alias/redwood-prod-ops (keyId: 1234abcd-ef56-7890). Use this lambda-friendly AWS CLI snippet to pull events:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=1234abcd-ef56-7890 --start-time 2024-11-02T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-03T00:00:00Z
```
I'll export those events + CloudWatch metric snapshots.

deploy-bot: Notice: KMS key alias/redwood-prod-ops had a rotation config change 2024-11-02T12:23:45Z (auto-rotation toggled=false).

olivia_p: For packaging: we should produce a signed manifest that lists each file + sha256 + ingest path. Also include a short narrative that maps each artifact to the SOC control (e.g., CC6.1 -> change logs). I'll draft the narrative and redaction rules (PII/ip redaction).

lina_h: auditor — question: can we redact caller IP addresses in the CloudTrail/Splunk exports? our policy redacts internal IPs but auditors sometimes require originals. We can provide redacted copies first and a secure onsite access for originals.

auditor_jen: We need originals for verification, but redacted copies are fine for initial upload. Originals can be reviewed under NDA in the secure bucket. Document the redaction process (script + hash of original) in the manifest.

olivia_p: noted. I'll include the redaction script and an HMAC of originals. Also will include the manifest entry: "originals: s3://redwood-compliance/originals/T3172718281/" and "redacted: s3://redwood-compliance/redacted/T3172718281/" (we'll only share redacted links publicly).

sam_oncall: ETA: I can drop Splunk JSON + screenshots into the redacted folder by EOD PST. matt_s will add KMS exports. lina_h will attach the change request + TICKET-4591 link.

lina_h: I'll also attach a short timeline: 2024-11-02 11:05 UTC - vuln reported; 11:40 UTC - emergency RBAC bind applied; 12:10 UTC - triage decision to revert; 12:30 UTC - RBAC reverted; all items in ticket.

auditor_jen: Perfect. Please ping me here when uploads are complete and include the manifest SHA256. We aim to close the control by Friday. Thanks all. :pray:
